WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    YEAR(service_date) AS yr,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MONTH(service_date)) AS months_covered,
    100.0 * SUM(ontime_pickups) / SUM(total_pickups) AS ontime_pct
  FROM pickup_otp_daily
  WHERE standard ILIKE '%30%'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  yr AS year,
  ROUND(ontime_pct, 1) AS ontime_pct
FROM yearly
WHERE months_covered = 12
ORDER BY ontime_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

  FROM complaints_daily
  WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND opened_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

  CASE WHEN isodow(service_date) >= 6 THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type,
  SUM(trips) AS total_trips,

  AND service_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    YEAR(service_date) AS yr,
    SUM(trips) AS total_trips,
    MIN(service_date) AS first_day,
    MAX(service_date) AS last_day,
    COUNT(DISTINCT service_date) AS days_present
  FROM trips_daily
  GROUP BY 1
),
full_years AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM yearly
  WHERE first_day = MAKE_DATE(yr, 1, 1)
    AND last_day = MAKE_DATE(yr, 12, 31)
    AND days_present = (MAKE_DATE(yr, 12, 31) - MAKE_DATE(yr, 1, 1)) + 1
)
SELECT
  yr AS year,
  total_trips AS trips
FROM full_years
ORDER BY total_trips ASC
LIMIT 1;
notes: Assumes trips_daily covers all provider types and boroughs (summed together), and "full calendar year" means a year with data present for every day from Jan 1 to Dec 31, so partial edge years are excluded.

WITH c AS (
  SELECT provider_type, SUM(complaints) AS complaints
  FROM complaints_daily
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM opened_date) = 2025
  GROUP BY provider_type
),
t AS (
  SELECT provider_type, SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM service_date) = 2025
  GROUP BY provider_type
),
j AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(c.provider_type, t.provider_type) AS provider_type,
         c.complaints,
         t.trips

)
SELECT provider_type,
       complaints,
       trips,
       ROUND(1000.0 * complaints / trips, 1) AS complaints_per_1000_trips
FROM j
UNION ALL
SELECT 'All providers',
       SUM(complaints),
       SUM(trips),
       ROUND(1000.0 * SUM(complaints) / SUM(trips), 1)
FROM j
ORDER BY provider_type
